{{Quote|You should know better than invade my kitchen on baking day.''"<br />"''Then you shouldn't let the smell into the garden.''"<br />"''You must be here for the meeting. You can go though those doors and turn left for the reception rooms. Here. I'll be bringing refreshments to the meeting, but you can sneak a piece. One slice, that's all.''"<br />"''Best in the galaxy.''"<br />"''I don't fall for flattery.''"<br />"''I didn't think you would.|[[Ferus Olin]] sampling [[Memily]]'s bread|<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: Master of Deception">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Master of Deception]]''</ref>}}
'''Bread''' was a type of food prepared by cooking a dough of ingredients and baking it in an oven.<ref name="The Paradise Snare">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref> It had an outer crust<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref> and contained [[Grain/Legends|grain]].<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref>

Bread was enjoyed by a number of [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was often served in slices.<ref name="Master">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Master of Deception]]''</ref> Once baked, it could subsequently be toasted.<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege" /> It could be topped with butter<ref name="Healer">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref><ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth" /> and various spreads, such as [[Honey/Legends|honey]]<ref name="Master" /> or [[jam]].<ref name="Healer" />

[[Human/Legends|Humans]] considered bread a symbol of nutrition par excellence. The common expression "take bread out of someone's [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]]" meant "deprive someone of livelihood." The [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] once used that metaphor when she blamed [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Valorum]] for allowing the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockade]] her [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="Star Wars Journal: Queen Amidala">''[[Star Wars Journal: Queen Amidala]]''</ref> The agricultural planet of [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]] was known as the "Bread-basket of [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]].<ref name="Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]''</ref><ref name="Operation: Elrood book">[[Operation: Elrood (book)|''Operation: Elrood'']]</ref>
